title: Prediction of Nonlinear Oscillations in a Jumping Quarter-Car Model Using Reservoir Computing
abstract: arXiv:2609.22205v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable prediction of vehicle dynamics is essential for smart driving applications such as autonomous control and advanced driver-assistance systems. Off-road vehicles used in agricultural and construction settings are particularly prone to nonlinear behavior, including bifurcations and chaotic motion arising from intermittent loss of tire--road contact. Predicting such dynamics is challenging because it requires resolving both smooth nonlinearities and the discontinuous switching associated with contact loss. In this work, we investigate the feasibility of reservoir computing (RC) -- specifically an echo state network (ESN) -- for data-driven prediction of a jumping quarter-car model. The reservoir is trained on time-series data from a small number of points and evaluated on its ability to reconstruct bifurcation diagrams, phase-space attractors, and time trajectories across periodic and chaotic regimes. translated_title: 使用储备池计算预测跳跃式四分之一车辆模型中的非线性振荡
translated_abstract: 可靠的车辆动力学预测对于自动驾驶控制和高级驾驶辅助系统等智能驾驶应用至关重要。用于农业和建筑环境的越野车辆特别容易出现非线性行为，包括由轮胎与道路接触间歇性丧失引起的分岔和混沌运动。预测此类动力学具有挑战性，因为它需要同时处理平滑非线性以及与接触丧失相关的不连续切换。在这项工作中，我们研究了储备池计算（RC）——特别是回声状态网络（ESN）——用于跳跃式四分之一车辆模型数据驱动预测的可行性。储备池在来自少量状态点的时间序列数据上进行训练，并评估其重构分岔图、相空间吸引子以及周期和混沌状态下的时间轨迹的能力。训练后的储备池在定性上……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究验证了回声状态网络（储备池计算）能够从少量时间序列数据中学习，有效预测跳跃式四分之一车辆模型在周期与混沌状态下的非线性动力学，包括重构分岔图和相空间吸引子。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that an echo state network (reservoir computing) can learn from a small amount of time-series data to effectively predict the nonlinear dynamics of a jumping quarter-car model, including reconstructing bifurcation diagrams and phase-space attractors across periodic and chaotic regimes.
